## Introduction

In this course we covered flowcharts and pseudocode. This page includes practice problems on following flowcharts and pseudocode, and putting algorithm steps in order.

## How To Use This Page

For each problem, use the **↻ New variant** button to generate a new problem of that type. Use the **Check** button to check your answer. Use the **Show answer** button to see the answer and an explanation. Problems that ask you to write Python run your code in the browser; the first run downloads the Python runtime (about 10 MB).

[Review the lesson](../../lessons/01%20Introduction%20to%20Algorithms/index.qmd){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
